before.body:
## Outcome and scope

This consolidates four independently reviewed repair/recovery areas onto the latest PR344 integration source. It remains **draft** because full/combined local qualification was interrupted and final-source hosted/native gates are required.

### Changes and resulting behavior

- **Report exports:** recover only donor specifications/tests `ddbcacf4` and implementation `b3d7d399`. A consumed staging name is not unlinked after success; secondary cleanup errors preserve the original typed failure or interruption.
- **TaskRunner lifecycle:** recheck generation, owner lifetime and visibility after final progress. Cancelled/replaced outcomes are discarded, hidden outcomes are parked without replaying progress, and callback failures release retained closures.
- **Linux Strings publication:** remove the unsafe named-source overwrite path. Both force values create a new destination exclusively and preserve any existing/concurrently arriving destination. **Linux overwrite is unavailable, including with `--force`.** Windows held-source replacement remains supported. CLI help, user guide and contracts disclose this change.
- **Accessibility recovery:** connect Evidence state announcements and recover escaped registered header-help support. The framework is ready for help IDs; 90 direct application column construction sites currently provide none, so per-column wiring remains open.

The refreshed census records 354 remote branches and 59 tags: 128 topic heads already in main, 27 more in the candidate, 16 nonancestor patch-equivalent heads with semantics unreviewed, 181 unmatched heads, plus main/current. Local report/accessibility donors had failing baseline regressions; already implemented audit/help scopes were excluded. Original refs and failures are retained.

## Verification and limitations

| Selection | Result | Boundary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Expanded report repair selection | 101 passed | Earlier integrated report source |
| TaskRunner author affected selections | 195 unique passed | Two disjoint selections; peer replays overlap |
| Linux publication maintained selection | 382 passed, 3 native Windows skips | Independently replayed; counts must not be added |
| Accessibility maintained selection | 283 passed | Source-pinned isolated import separately verified, overlapping |
| Earlier g34–g40 review | 86 passed, 1 native skip | Exact PR344 source |
| Independent g41 review | 36 passed | Exact PR344 source |
| Final-source bounded batch 3 | **429 passed, 2 native skips** | 16 files / 431 cases |
| Whole-tree Ruff / dependencies / whitespace | Passed | No checks or thresholds weakened |
| Source integrity | 8 production blobs match reviewed sources | Full local/remote publication tree also matches |

No full or all-affected pass is claimed. Earlier full source `84798a04` collected 24,029 tests and was SIGKILLed after 329 completed node phases, with no JUnit. The final-source 43-file selection collected 1,012 cases and was also SIGKILLed without a terminal result. Two bounded portions then ended SIGKILL after 22.714 and 18.610 seconds; only the third completed. The similar approximately 130-second aggregate supervisor observations reflect ten-second polling and do not prove a watchdog. The unchanged table stress node passed once in isolation. Cause remains unestablished; no OOM, quota, Qt or timeout attribution is made.

The shared environment's older editable source was detected for `python -I`. A dedicated environment installs this checkout editable, verifies the isolated module path and reuses pinned dependencies without modifying them. Final attempted/bounded checks use that environment.

## Exact publication identity

- Source parent / PR344 head: `67f7e08ea9bee61653f8ab5ad66048d3e7141810`.
- Main at final read: `fdc2696c23bdbfe7668348f25e3b336ce33039f7`.
- Final runtime/test source: `1d0f60f3004db9e32f314518d5be661b85ef4d71`, tree `9d0fdec1a0f88920f1c3786cb9bbcfd6b87ccfae`.
- Final local publication: `93a9a7e87c9cc90409ba9592229340dddc288faf`.
- Remote publication: `39c38a02f126963fc03827fa49741255590227ad`.
- **Complete local/remote tree equality:** `c458f2bcdbafccb1704966d07c1809a323f7f540`.
- Local integration/review history through `9d357e542721308b48d10923b4e7c2d11e6d1573` is preserved in the verified bundle.

Publication used the connected GitHub Git Data API after ordinary CLI push lacked credentials. No force-push, main merge, release, deployment or retained-branch deletion occurred.

## Authoritative continuation

- [Engineering ledger](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/PatchTrace/blob/39c38a02f126963fc03827fa49741255590227ad/docs/engineering/task-ledger.json)
- [Consolidated report](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/PatchTrace/blob/39c38a02f126963fc03827fa49741255590227ad/docs/engineering/session-20261120-2bad.md)
- [Handoff](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/PatchTrace/blob/39c38a02f126963fc03827fa49741255590227ad/docs/engineering-handoffs/session-20261120-2bad.md)
- [Interruption diagnosis](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/PatchTrace/blob/39c38a02f126963fc03827fa49741255590227ad/docs/engineering/full-suite-stop-20261120-2bad.md)
- [Branch census](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/PatchTrace/blob/39c38a02f126963fc03827fa49741255590227ad/docs/engineering/branch-recovery-20261120-2bad.md)

Inspect final-source Linux/Windows QA, repeated Qt, native and package results before any guarded merge. Preserve Windows manual/trust/accessibility, Qt disposition, full raw input/index membership and separate L1/L2/L3 gates. Strong Linux overwrite remains unimplemented; individual header-help ID wiring is the next bounded feature scope. Do not infer new accuracy gains or duplicate recovered work.


## Post-publication coordination

- Fetch-back verification confirmed the complete remote tree matches local publication `93a9a7e8` at `c458f2bcdbafccb1704966d07c1809a323f7f540`; the local worktree is clean and main/base remained unchanged.
- Exact-head [QA/Windows run 44840721370](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/PatchTrace/actions/runs/44840721370) and [native run 44840721268](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/PatchTrace/actions/runs/44840721268) triggered. At the final read both full QA legs, five Qt jobs and five native jobs were queued; release-gate was skipped. Pending jobs provide no acceptance result.
- Parallel [PR #346](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/PatchTrace/pull/346) is a sibling on PR #344, published at `87328763478db060909b75cd6849295056f9b405`. Exact comparison identifies unique candidate-admission ordering repair `649ed46ead79ad12c9fa35085e704ac3f0d32631` and a separate inventory-replay repair `076c1ffaea35e922b206da5818023fe96459de23` for selective independent reconciliation. This session has not independently qualified that inventory implementation.
- Accessibility runtime overlaps: `gui/qt/table.py` and `gui/table_spec.py` are byte-identical; `ui_evidence.py` differs only in equivalent line wrapping. Keep one implementation and preserve useful distinct tests/evidence. Do not merge broad status files wholesale. Reconcile the sibling's unique work and dispositions into the authoritative task ledger after its ownership handoff.
- This session's nine assignments are finished. The existing hourly continuation is enabled and updated to this exact checkpoint, the sibling identities, remaining gates, and ownership boundaries. The separate session's recorded hold remains until 2026-11-21 03:00 UTC or an explicit coordinated handoff; handoff-ready records alone do not prove worker liveness.

before.title: Consolidate reviewed GUI recovery and request/inventory repairs [no release]
before.body:
## Why this change is needed

The latest candidate still allowed malformed candidate requests to reach current-project verification before refusal, retained two missing GUI behaviors on an older branch, and could not replay its own captured branch inventory because one evidence field exceeded Python's default CSV limit.

This stacked draft consolidates the reviewed repairs and preserves their source-specific evidence. Full qualification is incomplete, so main promotion remains blocked.

## Changes

- Move candidate component/start-mode admission before current-input verification and workspace-service construction for both candidate operations, preserving cancellation and invalid-mode precedence.
- Selectively recover registered table-header help and Evidence StateView announcements from retained PR #321. Preserve newer Evidence attempt-storage, lifecycle and result-accounting behavior.
- Bound inventory snapshot reads to 32 MiB, accept the tool's larger quoted fields, translate CSV failures, and restore the previous process CSV limit. Replay the actual 353-topic snapshot byte-for-byte.
- Complete actual form-feed/unchanged-JSON and Qt timeout fallback tests. These are coverage additions; no serializer production defect is claimed.
- Add the six authoritative engineering indexes, source/commit mappings, nine historical semantic dispositions, raw evidence archive and local code-history bundle.

Candidate admission, GUI recovery and inventory repairs received independent review. A separate publication audit verified counts, source identities, links and artifact hashes; its handoff-index finding is corrected and independently closed.

## Exact identities

| Role | Identity |
| --- | --- |
| Parent PR #344 | `67f7e08ea9bee61653f8ab5ad66048d3e7141810` |
| Captured main | `fdc2696c23bdbfe7668348f25e3b336ce33039f7` |
| Frozen local tested code | `ccc3664f11a81d3d30f907da36fc3d22da0063d0` |
| Tree-identical remote code | `406acf96f5b1a299aca940f98eeb69d0b9583729` |
| Shared code tree | `a72efdcbf503e0480a182fd323c5c4320d27c098` |
| Final local documentation/evidence head | `23fcd34d7fa8db203557d6b89fbd114898938ca5` |
| Published head | `c07774ecf5a3f7337834f95a9a4c51c8ec5fad44` |
| Final published tree | `8b3b62b05bb6e7bd9eb5de8cbda797aceca52ca0` |

Git Data API publication preserves all nine code commits' tree contents and parent topology, including three local merges. Author/committer metadata changes commit IDs. Four later documentation commits leave application source, tests, tools, configuration and workflows unchanged. The [mapping](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/PatchTrace/blob/c07774ecf5a3f7337834f95a9a4c51c8ec5fad44/docs/engineering/evidence/cycle95fe/code-commit-mapping.json) and verified bundle preserve original local identities.

## Verification

| Check | Actual result |
| --- | --- |
| Clean combined-source admission selection | 183 passed, no skips |
| Clean combined-source changed cases | 50 passed, no skips |
| Reconciled combined-source union | **212 distinct passing cases**: 183 + 50 − 21 shared |
| Whole-tree Ruff | Passed on frozen combined source |
| Dependency consistency, protobuf pin/upb, CLI help | Passed; standalone clean-source receipts retained |
| Captured inventory replay | Byte-identical; SHA-256 `d82d52544646eb029f38684e2dd3802ffa1596c7eb02d5c11d0ae0b5783aa902` |
| Full local suite | SIGKILL / -9 after 23.089 s, before first test-start; no summary/JUnit |
| Larger bounded attempts | SIGKILL after 70.395, 32.827 and 21.474 s; no summary/JUnit |
| Final-head hosted QA/Qt/native/package | Pending |
| Real Windows manual/accessibility/trust | Unverified |

The successful union spans two bounded runs, not a full suite. Earlier worker selections overlap and are not added to it; the GUI worker's separate 212-case result has a different complete source tree. Original baseline failures and all four interrupted runs are retained. Independent diagnosis does not establish the SIGKILL sender or cause. No OOM, fixed-timeout, or GUI-regression cause is asserted. No test budget, skip policy or workflow gate changed.

## Consolidation and ownership

The frozen inventory covers 354 branches including main, 334 PRs and 59 published prereleases. Nine further historical scopes are accounted for: eight reviewed product behaviors are superseded and one branch is already in main ancestry. Branches remain retained. PR #321 is only selectively recovered; its other features still need review.

The other active foreground retains ownership of TaskRunner lifecycle, report-cleanup outcomes and Linux forced-export publication. Its refs were not modified.

## Handoff and merge gates

- [Current worker handoff](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/PatchTrace/blob/c07774ecf5a3f7337834f95a9a4c51c8ec5fad44/docs/engineering/WORKER_HANDOFF.md)
- [Consolidation ledger](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/PatchTrace/blob/c07774ecf5a3f7337834f95a9a4c51c8ec5fad44/docs/engineering/CONSOLIDATION_LEDGER.md)
- [Qualification and interruption limits](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/PatchTrace/blob/c07774ecf5a3f7337834f95a9a4c51c8ec5fad44/docs/engineering/cycle-95fe-qualification.md)
- [Evidence archive, manifests, bundle and independent audit](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/PatchTrace/tree/c07774ecf5a3f7337834f95a9a4c51c8ec5fad44/docs/engineering/evidence/cycle95fe/)
- [Integration queue](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/PatchTrace/blob/c07774ecf5a3f7337834f95a9a4c51c8ec5fad44/docs/engineering/INTEGRATION_QUEUE.md)

Keep this PR draft until applicable final-source gates and blocking findings permit promotion. Reconcile the separate foreground only after its handoff. Main has not moved. No release, deployment, force push or branch deletion is part of this PR.

## Concurrent sibling reconciliation

The parallel foreground published [PR #345](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/patchtrace/pull/345) at `39c38a02f126963fc03827fa49741255590227ad`, from the same parent. Direct Git comparison confirms identical table-spec/table-model and GUI-specification blobs. Evidence source differs only in line wrapping and has an identical whole-file AST. Count this shared GUI recovery once. Retain PR345's additional GUI assertions/tests, this branch's admission/inventory/coverage changes, and the sibling's separately qualified report, TaskRunner and Linux publication repairs.

The documentation-only follow-up records the first publication receipt and this overlap. It changes no tested application code, tests, tools, configuration or workflows. Reconcile both ledgers field-by-field after their final-source gates and ownership handoff; neither draft has been merged into the other or main. [Exact initial receipt and overlap](https://github.com/djshellshoxxx/PatchTrace/blob/c07774ecf5a3f7337834f95a9a4c51c8ec5fad44/docs/engineering/evidence/cycle95fe/initial-publication.json).
